justification: Inspected javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/declarations/JavaParserEnumDeclaration.java. ValuesMethod is a compact nested adapter (lines 344-432) with a single responsibility: modeling the implicit enum values() method. It has 17 small/interface-driven methods, mostly straightforward metadata accessors or one-line returns/unsupported-operation stubs, no internal branching or multiple domains of logic, and the sibling implicit method valueOf() is already split into a separate nested class in the same file.
